caveats: Timing labels are provisional: 20 press releases were looked up and every other event keeps the calendar's label (not_checked) until SEC EDGAR is set up, so a few events may sit on the wrong day 0. Every number here depends on those labels.

Implied: at day -1, E (event variance) and sigma_d (ordinary variance per session = sigma_d^2/252, ADR 0003 §c). The expected |move| of a normal move with variance E + sigma_d^2/252 is sqrt(2/pi) sqrt(E + sigma_d^2/252); it is exceeded 42.5% of the time, not 50%, when pricing is fair.
Realised: r0, the log change of the option-implied forward from day -1 to day 0 plus carry (DoltHub option quotes), on the same expiry both days.

H7's Wald test failed gate G1's size check (its calibrated null rejects 16.15% at 5%, band upper edge 6.30%): the test is liberal on this design, so a rejection by it would not be trusted. H7 stays in the declared Holm family (ADR 0005 §5, dated note of 2026-10-29) with this p-value; its Holm p is 1.0, not rejected. The coefficient and share p-values come from the same kind of two-way statistic.
